name: keyhalt
description: Keyhalt — native NEAR account-fleet key-lifecycle control plane (testnet, unaudited)

scripts.build: tsc -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/api/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/console/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/sdk/test/sdk.test.mjs packages/cli/test/cli.test.mjs packages/api/test/api.test.mjs packages/console/test/console.test.mjs packages/mcp/test/mcp.test.mjs
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/sdk/dist packages/cli/dist packages/api/dist packages/console/dist packages/mcp/dist
